name: meerkat
description: Meerkat monitors active coding agents and runs bounded Pi tasks with token and time limits.

interface.shortDescription: Watch active coding agents and run bounded Pi development tasks.
interface.longDescription: Meerkat shows how many coding agents are active and what they are doing. Its first developer runtime is Pi: Codex prepares a clean linked worktree and task brief, the runner enforces token and time limits, Pi codes and commits, and Codex reviews the local result. The read-only monitor shows task, model, worktree, and elapsed time. An optional, non-official desktop adapter shows that monitor inside Codex when launched with a loopback debugging port.
interface.defaultPrompt: Prepare a clean linked worktree and task brief for this task, run it once with the Pi one-task runner, and review the resulting local commit.
